description: List published questionnaires, tests and task maps to assess AI readiness, AI literacy, staff attitudes or which tasks suit AI, best tested first, optionally by kind or free to use. Fetch the ones that fit with get_evidence for how well each has been tested, who answers it, its length, licence and cost. For advice on what to do, use find_practices.

free_only.description: Only assessments that are free to use.

kind.description: The kind key from start, e.g. readiness-surveys or ai-knowledge-tests-and-self-ratings.

name: find_readiness_assessment
title: Find an AI readiness or literacy assessment
